title: Why etcd
summary: etcd is a strongly consistent, distributed key-value store. etcd uses the Raft consensus algorithm to replicate data across a cluster.

key_points.claim: etcd is a strongly consistent, distributed key-value store
key_points.quote: etcd is a strongly consistent, distributed key-value store.

key_points.claim: etcd uses the Raft consensus algorithm to replicate data across a cluster
key_points.quote: etcd uses the Raft consensus algorithm to replicate data across a cluster.

key_points.claim: Kubernetes stores all of its cluster state in etcd
